profile_metadata.comparison: Application-profile comparison, not an isolated engine change. Compare with --allow-workload-change.
profile_metadata.durability: Original durable settings and size limits retained. Only genuinely certified reads may reuse the already durable root.
profile_metadata.full_data_validation: Existing six-cell ReadRow program, additionally read-only-certified; all rows still verified outside timed samples.
profile_metadata.join: One generic actual-enumeration transaction; child-parent inner join, no row bound or cached answers.
profile_metadata.logical_workloads: Original scenario inputs, exact-type oracle, sample order, checks and timing boundary are reused unchanged.
profile_metadata.point_reads_and_keys: One separately read-only-certified Reader program; normal fresh authentication and artifact checks.
profile_metadata.query_registration: SUM and JOIN use ordinary universal opcode 0 with actual-state termination; no read-only lane is claimed for them.
profile_metadata.setup: All six programs are actually admitted/prepared and their setup costs are included, including after service reopen.
profile_metadata.sum: One generic actual-enumeration transaction; exact signed64 checked accumulation, empty zero, overflow refusal.

scope_notes: Feasibility-sized synthetic fixtures: eight rows per table, with schema complexity varied; not a row-count scaling study.
One client, durable writes, warmed caches and prepared JayDB2 programs; setup/preparation excluded from workload samples.
Successful scenario medians are equally weighted. Relationship JOIN has up to nine scenarios; the single-table project has no join. Completed failures are retained but have no timing values.
Sample p95 is nearest-rank over the small measured sample set, not a reliable population tail estimate.
RSS scopes differ; summed RSS double-counts shared pages and 10 ms sampling may miss peaks. SQLite includes the Python harness.
Storage scopes differ: PostgreSQL catalogs, live SQLite WAL/SHM, and JayDB2 snapshot storage exclude/include different overheads.
Schema/client setup excludes initial PostgreSQL cluster startup but includes JayDB2 startup and certified-program compilation.
workload_note: SQL SUM/JOIN are one native query; JayDB2 SUM/JOIN each use one generic prepared transaction over actual keys. Point reads use a separately read-only-certified Reader. All six program preparation costs are measured separately. This application profile changes the access strategy and does not isolate an engine improvement.
